title: Call to Art Bell show and emails with an author who couldn't corroborate his account
summary: Richard tells of Call to Art Bell show and emails with an author who couldn't corroborate his account, about Art Bell era, unspecified at Coast to Coast AM radio / email, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Coast to Coast AM radio / email

tellings.quote: he couldn't include me any further books because he couldn't collaborate it,

plain: A man named Richard, who calls himself a witness to strange events and who once worked as a guard at a nuclear missile site, says he called in to Art Bell's late-night radio show, Coast to Coast AM, and later traded emails with an author. According to Richard, the author told him he could not put his story in any more books because he could not back it up with other sources. He tells it to explain why his account stayed out of print for so long.
